items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: He's had Louis James out there too. He's good too.

ctx.x: He's been having drag pretty regularly out there just recently but he did have Eddie Dorsey out there. Yeah, I know
drag been out there more than any of those fellas. But there was some good bass players to Eddie Dorsey. He's had Louis James out there too. He's good too.
I used to like your cousin Austin Young was playing on bass.
